annotation.title_clean: Part 101 Gyrogliders and Parasails and Unmanned Balloons, Kites, and Rockets – Operating Rules
annotation.title_en: Part 101 Gyrogliders and Parasails and Unmanned Balloons, Kites, and Rockets – Operating Rules
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Civil Aviation Safety Authority of Papua New Guinea
annotation.summary_en: Papua New Guinea Civil Aviation Rule Part 101 (Amendment 3, Nov 2021) sets operating rules for moored and free balloons, kites, rockets, control line and free flight model aircraft, gyrogliders and parasails. Remotely piloted aircraft were moved to Part 102. It is conventional aviation safety regulation with no AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Part 101 applies to unmanned balloons, kites, rockets, model aircraft, gyrogliders and parasails; RPAs moved to Part 102
Operators must minimise hazards and notify the Director of serious injury or property damage
Pre-launch notices to the NOTAM office required for rockets and medium/heavy free balloons
Heavy free balloons need independent flight-termination devices and radar reflectors
Parasail rules cover safety equipment, wind limit of 20 knots and passenger age limits
